speaker: The Chairman
text: Main and Development Estimates of Expenditure of Singapore for the financial year 1 April 2016 to 31 March 2017, contained in Paper Cmd 2 of 2016.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I must remind hon Members that the total time for discussion of each Head of Expenditure includes the replies from the Front Bench.

speaker: The Chairman
text: With the assistance of the digital timer in the Chamber – which some of you have observed has actually grown bigger – I trust that hon Members will be able to keep to the speech times indicated against their amendments.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I would urge hon Members, both from the back and front benches, to adhere to their time limits, as I will be very stringent in my timekeeping.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I shall deal first with the Heads of Expenditure in respect of which amendments stand on the Order Paper Supplement.
